notes: Nill Download Manager 2.0.7 is a reliability release — every issue from a full audit of the engine, the app and the browser extension, fixed. Downloads can no longer be lost or misreported. A full disk now surfaces as an honest error instead of taking the app down; servers that refuse range requests or answer with encoded bodies produce a clean retry or a clean error, never a fake Finished file; automatic retries stop at their limit instead of running forever. Pausing and restarting keeps exactly the bytes that are safely on disk — long Bengali filenames included — and a finished merge survives a restart instead of downloading everything again into a duplicate. Pressing Start a second time while a download is still starting changes nothing. The browser hand-off now follows the rule professional download managers use: the browser copy is paused first and removed only once NDM has confirmed it owns the download; if anything fails, the browser download simply resumes — a download always exists somewhere. Queue limits hold on every start path, the update offer can no longer be missed on a cold start, and a required-update state clears itself if the feed is corrected. 2.0.7 is a required update for older versions.
